## Description

Aggregates do not permit trailing commas. JS/Python-influenced generators emit `(1.,2.,3.,)`. Recursive-descent grammars that accept it append a default-constructed element, mismatching schema-declared count.

## Reproducer recipe

`#1=DIRECTION('',(1.,0.,0.,));`

## Expected kernel behavior

Strict reject; lenient strip and warn.
